notes:
Replication values are author-derived primary project-table values, not independently converted. Original primary source verified. Figure 1 prints separate neuroticism-marital-stability coefficients: wives −.22 (7 studies) and husbands −.20 (6 studies). No single pooled coefficient, pooled analytic participant N, or associated p is printed; no averaging or sign reversal performed. No individual narrative success verdict located; numeric success coding is not treated as narrative.
Completion source review (n_r): Table 1 explicitly lists one test and its replication sample size. No arithmetic or recruitment-total substitution.
Completion source review (es_value_r): Printed observed effect .10, corrected effect .10 retained in notes. Generic printed metric retained; r versus standardized coefficient is not independently distinguishable per row. No metric or sign conversion.
Completion source review (pval_value_r): Explicit two-tailed p < .05 success definition and 100% success for exactly one test establish same-test bound. Exact p not supplied.
Completion source review (reported_success): Authors explicitly label column replication success rate, observed/corrected 100/100. Observed author summary mapped to successful; corrected summary retained in notes. No new significance-based verdict.
